changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Add compatible planning-context defaults to the canonical warehouse policy. A default category is backfilled only when the plan has exactly one confirmed category; ambiguous plans remain explicit.
changeSet.sql: update modeling_warehouse_plan_policy policy set default_business_category_id = candidates.domain_id from ( select tenant_id, plan_id, max(domain_id::text)::uuid as domain_id from modeling_warehouse_plan_domain where confirmation_status = 'CONFIRMED' group by tenant_id, plan_id having count(distinct domain_id) = 1 ) candidates where policy.tenant_id = candidates.tenant_id and policy.plan_id = candidates.plan_id and policy.default_business_category_id is null;

rollback.sql: alter table modeling_warehouse_plan_policy drop constraint ck_warehouse_plan_business_process_mode; alter table modeling_warehouse_plan_policy drop constraint ck_warehouse_plan_business_category_mode;
